description: Image-reading sub-skill (orchestrated by study-assistant; also usable standalone). Use for ANY study material that must be visually inspected: scanned textbook pages, courseware figures/charts/diagrams, photographed exam papers, photos of handwritten answers or notes, and png/jpg/jpeg/gif/webp/bmp files. Supports OCR, teaching-grade figure descriptions, and verbatim handwritten-answer transcription.
